result.title: E-Waste-Bench: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Visual Triage of Data-Center Hardware
result.summary: Retired data-center hardware can often be refurbished or resold, but triage demands more than object categories. A model must tell visually similar parts apart, judge condition under damage and occlusion, and read the printed part number. We audit nine public e-waste collections. They cover mostly consumer devices (only 10% of images are labeled as a data-center part), label neither condition nor printed text, and contain 42% exact or augmented duplicates. We introduce E-Waste-Bench, 328K photographs drawn from 762K deduplicated images and labeled for class (24 classes), granularity, condition and printed text. Images come from those collections and the web, where a recipe-based crawler works beside an agent built on an open-weight vision-language model. The agent vets new sources and reads sites the crawler cannot parse, and both are steered toward under-represented classes. Training labels are model-made, splits follow near-duplicate groups, and human annotators label a test set of nearly 10,000 images. We benchmark classification, condition, detection, text perception and cross-dataset transfer. On this test set, a ConvNeXt-T trained on E-Waste-Bench reaches 64.3% top-1, against 31.5% with the public collections alone. Near-duplicate leakage inflates top-1 by 3.0 points under model-made test labels but by less than 0.1 under human labels, so model-labeled benchmarks need group splits. Accuracy falls to 42.1% on marketplace and auction photographs, the closest proxy for hardware leaving service. Data and code will be released.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文构建 E-Waste-Bench：从九个公开电子废弃物图像集与网页抓取中整理出 32.8 万张照片，标注类别、粒度、损伤状况与印刷编号，用开放权重 VLM 智能体辅助筛选新来源，并在近万张人工标注测试集上评测分类、状况判断、检测、文字感知与跨数据集迁移。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「遮挡下的状况判断＋读取印刷编号」多属性标签或可作为 VLM 是否保留并实际使用细粒度视觉证据的诊断资源，且近重复分组划分发现泄漏可高估 3.0 点的结论，对 latent/视觉推理基准的评测设计可供核查；但论文本身不做内部状态或 latent 分析。
